Coca-Cola's gross profit fell by roughly 4.5% from fiscal Q1 2023 to fiscal Q4 2023. This is an estimate: I worked partly from memory of the reported figures and did not verify every quarterly number against the filings.

- **Q1 2023:** Net operating revenues were about $10,975M and cost of goods sold about $4,402M, giving gross profit of about $6,573M.
- **Q4 2023:** Revenues were about $10,851M. Cost of goods sold of about $4,573M is the part I am least sure of. I backed into it from the full-year figure of about $18,520M, less my recalled Q1–Q3 amounts. That gives gross profit of about $6,278M.
- **Change:** (6,278 − 6,573) / 6,573 ≈ −4.5%.
